definitions.explanation: Japan's official system of recording family relationships, births, deaths, marriages, and divorces. Each household has a register that tracks its members' legal status. A fundamental part of Japanese administrative and legal life.

examples.japanese: {戸籍|こせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: To obtain a copy of one's family register.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{戸籍|こせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Your family register changes when you get married.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{本籍地|ほんせきち}→本籍地：16666_honsekichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}した→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: Since a certified copy of the family register is required for a passport application, I requested one from the office at my registered domicile.

notes:
USAGE:
The {戸籍|こせき} system is unique to Japan (and a few other East Asian countries). It records not just individuals but family units, tracking births, deaths, marriages, divorces, and adoptions. It differs from Western systems of birth certificates and civil registration.

A {戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん} (certified copy of the full register) or {戸籍|こせき}⟦{抄本|しょうほん}→抄本：29804_shouhon⟧ (partial extract) is required for many official procedures such as marriage, passport applications, and inheritance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}: certified copy of the family register (full)
- {戸籍|こせき}⟦{抄本|しょうほん}→抄本：29804_shouhon⟧: extract of the family register (partial)
- {戸籍|こせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to be entered into a family register (as with marriage)
- {本籍|ほんせき}: registered domicile (where the register is held)
- {戸籍|こせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{移|うつ}す→移す：10122_utsusu⟧: to transfer one's family register
